test_cases.title: A page shows the seeded customer and participant identifiers
acs: DERIVED: Order, customer and participant pages show the QAL number QAL/0432 and Lab Code 1300 of the signed-in participant (data/seed/apply.sql)
assumptions: The external site runs at http://localhost:1688 with the local debug SSO user, linked by data/seed/apply.sql to the participant with Lab Code 1300 of customer QAL/0432.
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.

steps.action: Open the route in the row.
Look for the text in the row.
Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.
